claims.claim_text: CARLA provides three sensing modalities: normal vision camera, ground-truth depth, and ground-truth semantic segmentation.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA provides normal vision camera, ground-truth depth, and ground-truth semantic segmentation sensing modalities.

claims.claim_text: Depth and semantic segmentation are pseudo-sensors that support experiments controlling for the role of perception.
claims.normalized_text: Depth and semantic segmentation pseudo-sensors support perception control experiments.

claims.claim_text: Additional sensor models can be plugged into CARLA via the API.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA API allows plugging in additional sensor models.

claims.claim_text: The semantic segmentation pseudo-sensor provides 12 semantic classes: road, lane-marking, traffic sign, sidewalk, fence, pole, wall, building, vegetation, vehicle, pedestrian, and other.
claims.normalized_text: Semantic segmentation pseudo-sensor provides 12 semantic classes including road, vehicle, pedestrian, and others.

claims.claim_text: CARLA provides measurements associated with the agent's state including vehicle location and orientation, speed, acceleration vector, and accumulated impact from collisions.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA provides agent state measurements: location, orientation, speed, acceleration, collision impact.

claims.claim_text: CARLA provides measurements concerning traffic rules including the percentage of the vehicle’s footprint on wrong-way lanes or sidewalks, traffic light states, and speed limits at the vehicle's location.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA provides traffic rule compliance measurements: wrong-way lane footprint, traffic light states, speed limits.

claims.claim_text: CARLA provides access to exact locations and bounding boxes of all dynamic objects in the environment.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA provides exact locations and bounding boxes of dynamic objects.

claims.claim_text: These signals play an important role in training and evaluating driving policies.
claims.normalized_text: Signals from CARLA sensors and measurements are important for training and evaluating driving policies.

claims.claim_text: CARLA supports development, training, and detailed performance analysis of autonomous driving systems.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA supports autonomous driving system development, training, and performance analysis.

claims.claim_text: The authors have used CARLA to evaluate three approaches to autonomous driving.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA was used to evaluate three autonomous driving approaches.
